input_contract: Training black-composited RGB, timestamps and supplied camera calibration only. RGBA alpha only produces the dataset RGB; never static/dynamic masks or alpha targets. No blue/yellow thresholds, original S1 weights/hull/selected tracks, instance/material IDs or object-number inputs.
tracking: 400px unmasked grayscale LK; forward/backward <0.5px, both errors<20; generic Shi-Tomasi features every4 train observations; no learned semantics
region_propagation: Generic Felzenszwalb RGB regions, scale100/sigma0.8/minsize60; at least2 fixed-world-point seeds and no incompatible-fixed-point seed; erode1; unseeded/mixed/occluded regions unknown
staticity_limit: Conditional observed-interval fixed-point compatibility is not proof of permanent physical stationarity
initialization_gate: At least12 accepted tracklets and100 supported static surface Gaussians; otherwise report insufficient evidence without color-prior fallback
initialization_support: Grid within accepted-track bounds plus0.16; nearest accepted triangulation <=0.12 scene units, >=8 positive projected masks, >=12 image-frustum observations, >=2 positives in at least2 global time thirds; shell only. No alpha/background/color negatives.
training_objective: Inferred-static-region RGB L1 +0.2 inferred-positive alpha coverage +0.01 position displacement; unknown image pixels have zero direct loss; original alpha channel never supplies targets.
full_training_gate: Unit tests, RGB-geometric discovery audit, actual inferred-mask inspection, renderer parity and independent40-to80 full-state recovery before formal training
selection: Use predeclared12k endpoint; no thresholds/weights swept after seeing results
evaluation: Held-observation reprojection and unknown coverage, native rendered image inspection and fixed86/188/original views. Any color/alpha-derived historical diagnostics are evaluation-only and cannot choose seeds, checkpoints or thresholds. No independent static/geometry GT currently available.
